notes: s015 could alternatively be read as a substantival participle under rule 46; either way the supplied 'that' stays in the participle's unit and the head is 'work'.
'let me not eat' divides with the negative on בַל and the whole volitive frame, including the subject pronoun, on the finite verb (rules 17, 35).

עֲלִלוֹת is absolute, so the 'of' at t012 answers to the בְּ standing in the clause and not to a construct relation (rules 11, 19); s013 is the preposition אֵת (H854), not the object marker (rule 16).
